request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin, wood and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the main subject of the photo whole inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps it whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

ONE student desk, alone. A small one-person school desk with a rectangular light-wood top, a shallow open shelf under the top and four gray metal legs stands on a plain light floor in front of a plain pale wall, seen from the front at a slight angle from above so the top and the legs are both clear. The desk top is completely empty. There is NO chair and no other furniture; no people, no bags, no books, nothing on the floor. The whole desk is sharp and large. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
